observations: Photo 0 shows a rechargeable-style standing fan with a wall/charging cable visible; fan head and blades are intact.
Photo 1 shows a close view of the fan; the center hub has a logo/mark that is not clearly readable, and the charging unit/handle area is visible but details are unclear.
No clear label/model number, battery capacity, or brand name is readable from the photos.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Brand 'Qasa' is not clearly readable on the fan in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low...
claims.evidence: Photos do not show battery runtime testing, charge level, or a working timer/measurement.

risks.risk: Battery health may be weak, so runtime could be far less than claimed.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running from full charge with a visible timer (e.g., phone stopwatch) at the stated speed settings until it stops.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a rechargeable fan with unknown/possibly reduced runtime (worst case: treat as not meeting the claimed 2 hours).

risks.risk: Charging may not work reliably (charger/cable/battery connection issue).
risks.proof: A short clip showing charging indicator (if any) and/or the fan charging from empty to full, plus it starting after charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to charge properly (worst case: treat as needs repair/uncertain charging).

risks.risk: Fan performance issues (wobble, bearing noise, weak airflow) not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running at low and high speed showing smooth rotation and airflow, plus any unusual sounds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible performance wear (worst case: treat as not fully strong on high).

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (could be a different rechargeable fan brand/model than 'Qasa').
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/label (brand, model, voltage) on the motor housing or battery/charger unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price generically as a used rechargeable standing fan without assuming the specific brand/model.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/label showing brand and model (on motor housing and/or battery/charger unit).
Video proof of charging: show it charging from low/empty to full (or show indicator) and then turning on.
Video proof of runtime: stopwatch timer while running at the claimed settings (high for ~2 hours claim, and low for longer).
Video showing the fan running smoothly at low and high (no wobble/noise).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a rechargeable standing fan, but the key pricing drivers—battery runtime and whether charging works—are not provable from images alone, and the claimed brand/model is not readable.
